top_findings.title: 'At least 3 tests' deliverable only partially met — 4 tests exist but none pass
top_findings.evidence: tests/test_api.py defines 4 async tests, but the actual scored run executed 0 of their bodies: .coverage shows only import/def/decorator lines covered (test_api.py lines 1-3,5,6,12,13,27,28,46,47) and no endpoint body in app/main.py ran. Reproduced: without pytest-asyncio all 4 FAIL ('async def functions are not natively supported'); with pytest-asyncio+httpx<0.28 only test_health passes and the other 3 fail 'sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: books' (AsyncClient(app=app) never triggers the lifespan init_db); with httpx>=0.28 all 4 fail (app= kwarg removed). 0 effective passing tests in every configuration. Count (>=3) is met; 'and run' is not.
top_findings.suggestion: Add pytest-asyncio to deps and configure asyncio_mode=auto; switch to transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app) and wrap in an ASGI lifespan manager (or use fastapi.testclient.TestClient) so init_db() runs and the DB table exists before requests.
